row.POLICY_TEXT: Newly onboarded suppliers (less than 12 months active) must be assigned maximum Net 30 payment terms.
Payment terms must not exceed 45 days.
Any agreement requiring advance or pre-payment requires explicit approval from the Procurement Director.
The delivery date must be no more than 30 calendar days after the purchase order date.
Delivery requests shorter than 7 calendar days require an expedited shipping approval code.
Non-USD purchase orders exceeding USD 50,000 equivalent valuation require Treasury hedging verification.
Allowed shipping terms: FOB Destination, CIF, DAP.
Cross-border international shipments must specify Customs Clearance Responsibility in the purchase order header notes.
TYPE: APPROVAL REQUIREMENT. Purchase orders with a gross amount greater than USD 10,000 require human review. This is an approval requirement and is not considered a compliance violation.
Purchase orders exceeding USD 50,000 require Vice President signature prior to release.
Category A raw materials require a minimum order quantity of 100 units per line item.
Quantity must be greater than zero.
For each line item, quantity multiplied by unit price must equal line-item net amount, with a tolerance of USD 0.01.
The sum of all line-item net amounts must equal the PO net amount, with a tolerance of USD 0.01.
